variance_sum <- 0.035^2 + 0.045^2
difference <- 0.025
target <- 0.90
critical <- stats::qnorm(1 - 0.01 / 2)
upper_n <- ceiling(variance_sum * ((critical + stats::qnorm(target)) / difference)^2)
n <- seq_len(upper_n)
se <- sqrt(variance_sum / n)
cutoff <- critical * se
power <- stats::pnorm(-cutoff, mean = difference, sd = se) +
  stats::pnorm(cutoff, mean = difference, sd = se, lower.tail = FALSE)
answer <- n[which(power >= target)[1L]]
note: The upper rejection tail supplies a search bound, and both tails determine the smallest qualifying sample size.
